changeLog: New in this version: every seat in the lobby has a Seat Settings window with any colour and a team; a Bonuses page for each seat's starting bonuses, with war machines and extra seconds on every turn; with a turn timer, each player's time left shows at the right end of their own turn bar in their colour, the bars always stand in one column, and the game's own timer box comes back only for a human who has no bar on your screen; objects on the adventure map are drawn in the right order; the hero picker's Random works while another seat holds the faction's first hero. With OmniMapGen 0.3.38: every slider with a Template notch starts in the middle, Classic maps follow the original scenarios more closely, roads bend more and rivers never run along a road, and the lobby's template pictures are redrawn. Everyone who plays together should update.
